user.title: Connect to Lights3D
user.description: Enable the Home Assistant bridge in Lights3D (Settings → Remote), then enter this PC's address and token.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Lights3D
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge rejected the token. Copy a fresh one from Lights3D Settings → Remote.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Lights3D
reconfigure.description: Update the PC address, port, or token for this desk.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Lights3D. Is the bridge on, and is the host/port right?
error.invalid_auth: Token was rejected. Copy a fresh token from Lights3D Settings → Remote.

abort.already_configured: This Lights3D bridge is already configured.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not find the integration entry to reauthenticate.
abort.wrong_account: Those settings belong to a different Lights3D bridge.
